about_the_game:
THE START OF A LEGENDARY D&D ADVENTURE  - Create your first character, fight monsters, save your friends, and embark on thrilling quests. This is the start of something legendary. This is D&D for everyone.

FAST FUN FOR FRIENDS AND FAMILY  - Heroes of the Borderlands is playable in bite-sized, hour-long sessions, perfect for game night with friends and family.

SET UP AND PLAY IN MINUTES  - Get straight to playing with speedy character creation, a handy quick-start guide, and intuitive, learn-as-you-play components.

GO ON EPIC QUESTS  - This product, adapted from three adventure booklets provide dozens of encounters involving combat, social interaction, and exploration.

CHOOSE YOUR WAY TO PLAY  - Do you fight the goblin, try to reason with it, or sneak past it undetected?

Make every game night unforgettable with Heroes of the Borderlands, a cooperative fantasy adventure game full of fast fun for your friends and family. Designed for 3–5 players, in each game, one player acts as Dungeon Master, while others act as heroes in an ever-evolving story. Together, you delve into monster-filled caves, explore untamed forests, and determine the fate of the Borderlands.

This product includes digital-only versions of these components:

  • 3 adventure books with preset encounters, token placement, maps, and boxed text

  • 8 character class summaries featuring iconic D&D classes input as pre-gen characters for use in Fantasy Grounds

  • 1 quick-start guide shareable for players

  • A reference manual you can read in Fantasy Grounds

  • 5 in-world immersive handouts (including a tavern menu and shop catalogs)

  • 18 maps featuring lighting, line of sight, and layers

  • New game card images (including spells, magic items, and equipment) with the back of the cards input into Fantasy Grounds format for playability

  • New Tokens and images for monsters, npcs, terrain, and resources

Adapted for Fantasy Grounds by: Doug Davison, Phillip Greig

Requires: An active subscription or a one-time purchase of a Fantasy Grounds license and the included D&D fifth edition ruleset.

Screenshots may differ from what you see in-game based on the extensions and ruleset you have loaded.

Designed for Fantasy Grounds version 4.7.1 and higher.
